study: S9 frozen fresh-regime and direct-reference validation
warm_scope: resident input, primed methods/decoder, fresh per-call allocations, input I/O and oracle checks outside timer
cold_scope: first encode/decode call in separate fresh processes; resident input and parsed policy; no priming; process startup and input I/O excluded, no claim of cold OS/page/disk caches
confidence: paired bootstrap of ten entire sessions; file/family population uncertainty is a separate scope
size_scope: release/min standalone linked probes retain shared method parser, including policy external payload; conservative prototype accounting, not a measured production integration
portability: performance claims only for actually measured host; Linux CI correctness is not second-hardware performance
promotion: all role, decode, tiny, RSS, linked-size and correctness gates must pass; new emitter structures additionally require model proof coverage
